description: Day 2 sequel to the posted sepatu clip: viewers still send Windah to the shoe store, he promises 'di akhiran', and the stream cuts off before he goes (idea B16). Source = .cache/wizzclip/windah-gtavi-sepatu2/source.mp4 (also Drive clip-src/windah-gtavi-sepatu2.mp4): SIX parts re-encoded to 1080p30 and joined with the concat demuxer, 35.25 s. Windah live QSPPyA1736U (19 Nov 2026, started 17:00:13 WIB). Part 1 local 0-6 = stream-1700-1800.mp4 t 62-68; part 2 local 6-11 = stream-1800-1852.mp4 t 1915-1920; part 3 local 11-20 = stream-1800-1852 t 2090-2099; part 4 local 20-28 = t 2257-2265; part 5 local 28-32 = t 2306-2310; part 6 local 32-35.23 = t 2992-2995.23 (the stream's last seconds; stream-1800-1852 t 0 = 18:00:13 WIB). Cuts: A62 t 64.30-67.15 = local 2.30-5.15 -> output 0.00-2.85; B1915 t 1916.85-1918.75 = local 7.85-9.75 -> output 2.85-4.75; B2090 t 2091.10-2098.15 = local 12.10-19.15 -> output 4.75-11.80; B2257 t 2258.50-2264.40 = local 21.50-27.40 -> output 11.80-17.70; B2306 t 2306.60-2309.40 = local 28.60-31.40 -> output 17.70-20.50; B2992 t 2993.00-2995.23 = local 33.00-35.23 -> output 20.50-22.73. Beats: 17:01:04 'mending diserang bocil sepatu daripada bocil lagu' (opener, callback to the posted windah-gtavi-sepatu clip); 18:32:10 chat line 'sepatu, sepatu, akhiran deh! sepatu!'; 18:35:04 'toko sepatu, coba siapa tuh udah liat spoiler, toko sepatu, gua coba di akhiran lah, sebelum gue live di YouTube resmi'; 18:37:51 reads chat 'sepatu ada di downtown', 'gue udah nyampe nih, deket kan?'; 18:38:39 'toko sepatu ya, toko sepatu bisa hari ini, bisa, bisa, bisa'; 18:49:46 'ya, daripada gue mati' and the stream cuts off (it ended unexpectedly), frozen 1.6 s with '...DAN STREAMNYA KEBURU SELESAI WKWK'. No swears, no guns in the cuts (skipped the drug-loot line at 18:49:40). Main 24.33 s + 4.0 s outro. Short format (user, 19 Nov: clips 45-60 s lost viewers at ~10 s, so aim for 20-30 s, payoff first). Clean layout as windah-gtavi-sepatu; hook line 1 Paper 'HARI KEDUA, MASIH DISURUH', line 2 Volt 'KE TOKO SEPATU WKWK', Audex 68. Word timings from faster-whisper medium on boosted audio. Cuts on input 0 stay in source order; an earlier-shown later moment has its own seeked input.
